significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) law plus a causal mechanism: across regulatory cascades, "direct edges will survive representational conditioning on mediators while indirect edges will vanish," and mediator clamping selectively blocks indirect perturbation propagation. This fixes expected conditional-dependence and intervention outcomes for whole families of direct-versus-mediated relationships, materially affecting interpretation of network and perturbation capabilities claimed for models such as Geneformer (Theodoris et al., Nature, 2023), scGPT (Cui et al., Nature Methods, 2024), and scFoundation (Hao et al., Nature Methods, 2024); it establishes both a representational phenomenon and a load-bearing internal mechanism rather than mere edge decodability. The branches are distinguishable and informative: a positive result supports conditional-independence structure, while consistently null CISI would support the stated conclusion that representations encode "marginal correlation, not conditional-independence structure," although a null perturbation result alone is less decisive because the claim explicitly allows a "head-limited" interpretation. In the topic-substitution check, the generic question of whether scientific mechanisms are represented would not earn this score; the direct/mediated conditional-independence relation and selective mediation blocking are the claim-specific constraints that place it above the topic median.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "Conditional-Independence Selectivity Index (CISI)" and "Mediation-Blocking Asymmetry (MBA)," which can audit whether an scFM distinguishes direct regulation from mediated association and whether that distinction controls perturbation propagation. They are primarily post-hoc representation diagnostics, but they can also be used ex ante to gate a pretrained model before treating it as a mechanistic prior for perturbation-guided discovery, providing an action window for model selection rather than forecasting individual biological failures. After re-extraction on another model, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—conditioned direct association should exceed conditioned indirect association and mediator blocking should preferentially reduce indirect effects—rather than merely supplying a search procedure; the asserted scope covers scFMs and regulatory cascades across cell types, with downstream uptake by model auditors and biological researchers choosing tools for regulatory inference. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: biology-model representations alone provide no reusable handle, whereas the quoted indices and direct-versus-mediated relation support reach above the topic-median probe or steering deliverable, though not broad enough for a 9–10 because their use depends on curated cascade knowledge and is largely confined to single-cell regulatory modeling.
